scope: Independent M5 implementation and verification; final gateway integration is excluded.
review_method: Independent source and recorded-evidence assessment; reviewer did not personally rerun the commands.

checks.name: Bootstrap and migrations
checks.notes: First-admin race, Secret-backed operator bootstrap/removal, exact 001-to-002 identity preservation and repeat migrations.

checks.name: Invitations
checks.notes: Concurrent one-use redemption, expiry/spent/invalid/duplicate cases and live member creation.

checks.name: Login, sessions and browser protection
checks.notes: Fixed expiry, rotation/logout, stable CSRF, exact Origin checks, cookie flags and bearer/cookie separation. Browser TLS is not claimed.

checks.name: Direct API permissions
checks.notes: Admin/member and own/other-user UUID boundaries enforced directly by the API.

checks.name: Personal keys
checks.notes: Hash-only at rest, one-time issuance, multiple keys, concurrent revocation and persisted active/revoked validators after replacement.

checks.name: Registry
checks.notes: CRUD, immutable slug, credential modes/retention/clear, safe summaries/statuses and durable actual credential resolution.

checks.name: Destination and header policy
checks.notes: Registration allowlist/HTTPS and reserved/invalid header rules. Connection-time DNS and redirects remain M6.

checks.name: Secret failure and recovery
checks.notes: Real PostgreSQL fault triggers, controlled remote failures, delayed creation/lock loss, durable tombstones and concurrent recovery; live ownership and UID guard.

checks.name: Effective RBAC
checks.notes: Actual owned Secret CRUD/metadata update and denied list/watch/foreign-namespace/workload calls, beyond rendered Role declarations.

checks.name: Activity lifecycle
checks.notes: Real failed initial/final SQL writes, all outcomes, one finalization, visibility and abandoned/current ownership. Activity fixtures are synthetic; no upstream dispatch.

checks.name: Durable restart
checks.notes: Actual database and harness replacement; exact private identity/registry row equality, credential match, same PVC UID and separate backup restore.

checks.name: Deployment, redaction and cleanup
checks.notes: Both renders, actual probes/resources/internal Services, image identity, 32-file credential scan with zero hits, owned namespace cleanup and original store resource preservation.

remaining_scope: M6 actual dispatch and existing MCP-session revocation, resolved-address policy and redirects
M8 browser pages and actual browser HTTPS/TLS
M10 final wiring and two-user end-to-end demonstration
